title: My Family
text:
My family lives in a small house in Madrid. There are four people in my family: my mother, my father, my sister, and me. My mother is a doctor. She works at a hospital near our house.

We eat dinner together every evening. My sister likes to cook pasta, and my father washes the dishes. On Sunday, we visit my grandmother. She always gives us big hugs.

questions.text: How many people are in the family?
How does the grandmother probably feel about the family?
What kind of family is this?
options: A family that spends time together
A family that lives far away
A family that never eats at home

vocabulary.definition: a group of people who are related to each other
a place where doctors and nurses look after sick people
with each other, in the same place
the mother of your mother or father

paragraph_translations: Mi familia vive en una casa pequeña en Madrid. En mi familia hay cuatro personas: mi madre, mi padre, mi hermana y yo. Mi madre es médica. Ella trabaja en un hospital cerca de nuestra casa.
Cenamos juntos cada noche. A mi hermana le gusta cocinar pasta, y mi padre lava los platos. El domingo visitamos a mi abuela. Ella siempre nos da abrazos grandes.
